Definition: Whether legal or regulatory requirements obligate payment service providers to notify users, regulators, and/or data protection authorities about payment data breaches, cybersecurity incidents, or unauthorized access within specified timeframes.
Comments: The Data Protection Act, 2023 includes mandatory breach notification: it provides for “Notification of a personal data breach to the Commission” and requires controllers to notify the Commission within 72 hours after becoming aware, plus communication to data subjects where required (sections on breach notification/communication).

Definition: Whether national data protection or privacy legislation exists and explicitly covers payment transaction data, including provisions on data collection, storage, sharing, retention, and user rights over their payment data.
Comments: Seychelles enacted a general data protection law: the Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act 24 of 2023) in the Official Gazette. The Act sets a general framework for personal data processing and creates a Data Protection Commission; it is not specific to payments (no payment-data-specific provisions identified).
